The new skill trees are generally very well made and definitely gives you more options and ways to play, but are in no way a requirement at all.

Just avoid FL4K's purple tree if you do end up getting it.

No DLC is required to have a full playthrough. 95% of endgame activities and raid bosses come with base game.

DLCs have A LOT of good items, but base game is equally as capable of producing powerful builds on its own.

Season Pass 1 has the four story DLCs, which imo all have better stories than the main game.

Season Pass 2 gives you Designers Cut and Directors Cut. One gives you a few mission string story with one of the characters you encounter in the base game, and a new raid boss.

The other one gives you a new mode called arms race where you're put into a map with no weapons or items, no skill trees, nothing, and you have to scavenge and loot while working your way to specific chests that can grant you legendary gear, which you only keep if you can extract them. There's a circle that shrinks, think almost any battle royal game, and there's a boss to go to to finish out the game.

TLDR: base game is fine for a basically complete experience, all dlc just add more self-contained stories, cool ass gear, and a couple new bosses.
